title: Nutritious Irish Cheese Grill
description: A quick and easy Irish dish featuring melted cheese, earthy flavors, and a hint of sweetness from demerara sugar, perfect for a diabetic-friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium heat.
Butter one side of each bread slice.
Place two slices of bread, butter side down, on the grill.
Top each bread slice with a slice of cheese, a sprinkle of demerara sugar, and a few leaves of thyme.
Place a grilled portobello mushroom on top of the cheese.
Place the remaining bread slices, butter side up, on top of the mushrooms.
Grill for 2-3 minutes or until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Flip the sandwiches over and grill for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also golden brown.
Serve immediately and top with fresh arugula.
